instruction: Generate a PDF file from the OIP.jpg receipt located in /home/user. Store the PDF as "transaction.pdf" on the desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task converts OIP.jpg to PDF as 'transaction.pdf' on Desktop. Evaluator verifies /home/user/Desktop/transaction.pdf exists with 1 page and valid image content.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks all requirements - file existence, valid PDF structure, correct page count (1 page for single image), and actual image content
Correct getter logic: get_vm_file correctly fetches the PDF from /home/user/Desktop/transaction.pdf
Correct metric logic: check_pdf_pages__296be19a properly validates page count (eq 1), file size threshold (>10KB), and verifies PDF contains embedded images via /XObject inspection
Appropriate expected values: ref_value=1 is semantically correct for single image-to-PDF conversion, verify_content=true ensures actual conversion happened
Proper content verification: Image detection logic checks for /XObject with /Subtype /Image which is the standard PDF method for embedded images
Adequate postconfig: 2-second sleep allows file system operations to complete before verification

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_pdf_pages__296be19a first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
